```plato
    // The transverse analysis of a beam discretised into `elementCount` uniform
    // elements: assemble, load, restrain, solve, and split the solution vector
    // into the deflection and rotation at each node.
    SolveBeam(b: Beam, elementCount: Integer, settings: LinearSolveSettings): BeamSolution
    {
        var dofCount = (elementCount + 1) * 2;
        var stiffness = SparseMatrix(dofCount, dofCount, b.BeamStiffnessEntries(elementCount));
        var solved = stiffness.SolveConstrained(b.BeamLoadVector(elementCount),
            b.BeamConstraints(elementCount), settings);
        var u = solved.Solution;
        return BeamSolution(
            b.BeamNodePositions(elementCount),
            (elementCount + 1).MapRange(i => u[i * 2]),
            (elementCount + 1).MapRange(i => u[i * 2 + 1]),
            solved.Iterations, solved.Residual, solved.Converged);
    }
```
